description.p: AnduinOS Help — native documentation browser for AnduinOS. Periodically clones the official AnduinOS-Docs git repository and indexes its Markdown into a local SQLite database, so search, navigation, and article rendering work fully offline after the initial sync. Source: https://github.com/AiursoftWeb/AnduinOS-Docs
